hero.title: Let AI find the meaning. Let Mingpan get the chart right.

evidence.title: One real call: how an AI obtains a deterministic chart through Mingpan
evidence.description: LLMs are strong at context and synthesis, yet they slip on solar-term boundaries, stem-branch arithmetic and Zi Wei star placement. Everything below was produced by the official stdio server — it is not illustrative copy.

steps.title: Birth data and a question, in plain language
steps.content: "Chart the BaZi and Zi Wei for a man born 1990-05-15 at 10:00 in Taipei, then talk me through his career direction."

steps.title: The AI assembles the parameters from the tool description
steps.content:
bazi_basic({
  year: 1990, month: 5,
  day: 15, hour: 10,
  gender: "male",
  timezone: "Asia/Taipei"
})
ziwei_basic({ …same birth parameters })

steps.title: Mingpan returns deterministic chart facts only — Chinese structured text, as the tool emits it
steps.content:
年柱：庚午　月柱：辛巳
日柱：庚辰　時柱：辛巳
天干十神：年比肩　月劫財　時劫財
月支藏干：丙七殺※ 戊偏印 庚比肩
命宮：癸未　胎元：壬申
——
本命命宮 戊子：破軍(廟)
身宮：夫妻　五行局：火六局
命主：貪狼　身主：火星
四化：祿太陽 權武曲 科太陰 忌天同

steps.title: The AI interprets on top of the facts; the reading belongs to the AI and may vary by school
steps.content: "Day Master Geng Metal born in a Si month: the month branch's principal qi is Bing Fire, Seven Killings in command, with Companion and Rob Wealth stems in the other three pillars — strong Killings, but the Day Master is supported. In Zi Wei, Po Jun sits alone in the Life Palace at temple brightness, the Body Palace falls in Spouse with Wu Qu (Power), and Tan Lang (temple) rules Career — career favours proactive pioneering, tempered through partnership and structure…"

contrast.badDesc: Misplaced solar-term cut-offs, confused early/late Zi hours, Zi Wei stars placed from memory.
contrast.goodDesc: Identical input always yields the identical chart; the rules are published, reproducible and checkable. The AI only interprets on top of the facts.

principles.title: Put calculation and interpretation where each belongs
principles.description: Mingpan is not another fortune-telling bot. It supplies reproducible chart facts and leaves contextual, human interpretation to the AI you choose.

items.title: Deterministic first
items.description: Pillars, solar terms, palaces, stars, and hexagrams are computed in code—not guessed by a language model.

items.title: Privacy by architecture
items.description: The official service is stateless and does not store or cache birth inputs or chart results.

items.title: Open and auditable
items.description: Source, dependencies, and tests are public so developers and researchers can inspect the calculation conventions.

capabilities.title: Natal charts, timing cycles, and divination through one endpoint
capabilities.description: Every tool returns structured text designed for AI consumption. Mingpan deliberately avoids fortune scores, pattern verdicts, and life conclusions.

items.title: BaZi
items.description: Four pillars, ten gods, hidden stems, na yin, growth stages, decade luck, and annual, monthly, and daily cycles.

items.title: Zi Wei Dou Shu
items.description: Twelve palaces, major and auxiliary stars, four transformations, five-element bureau, and multi-level timing cycles.

items.title: LiuYao
items.description: Primary and transformed hexagrams, Najia, six relatives, six spirits, host/guest lines, void, and hidden spirits.

items.title: MeiHua YiShu
items.description: Time- or number-based casting with primary, mutual, transformed hexagrams and body–function relations.

items.title: Da Liu Ren
items.description: Derives calendar primitives from Gregorian time and returns the heaven–earth plate, four lessons, three transmissions, and generals.

items.title: Qi Men Dun Jia
items.description: Multiple chart styles and intercalation methods, with the nine-palace chart and deterministic yong-shen facts by subject.

capabilities.calendarNote: Plus 2 calendar primitives: precise times for the 24 solar terms and Gregorian–lunar conversion.

connect.title: One endpoint is the whole configuration
connect.description: Mingpan is a standard MCP server and is not tied to any client. Any MCP-capable agent, IDE, CLI or SDK takes the endpoint wherever it asks for an MCP server — no API key, nothing to install.

remote.title: Official remote service
remote.description: Stateless pure computation: no chart database, no logging of birth parameters or results. Currently free for fair use.

local.title: Run locally
local.description: The same engine as a stdio process on your own machine; data never leaves the device. Requires Node.js.

connect.note: Per-client configuration locations and examples live in the GitHub README.

relationship.title: Mingpan computes the chart. BaziWei completes the experience.
relationship.description: Mingpan is an independent, open-source calculation foundation. BaziWei connects subject management, BaZi and Zi Wei, AI readings, calendars, and sharing into a complete product. They complement each other without forcing the same school of interpretation.
